# Anne-Mette Lange

Anne-Mette Lange is a clinical psychologist (klinisk psykolog) at the Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center (Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Center) at Aarhus Universitetshospital in Region Midtjylland [^src1][^src2]. She appears in the steering group documentation for the Danish ADHD database, a national health quality registry that monitors the assessment and treatment of ADHD in children and young people under 18 [^src1][^src2].

In listings from both 2023 and 2024, she is named as a member of the database's styregruppe (steering group), which brings together senior physicians, specialist doctors, psychologists, nurses, epidemiologists and relative/patient representatives from across Denmark [^src1][^src2]. By the 2024 listing, her affiliation is expanded to note her role as a representative of Dansk Psykolog Forening (the Danish Psychological Association) within the steering group [^src2], indicating that she serves not only in a clinical capacity but also as an organized professional voice for psychologists in the governance of the ADHD database. Her institutional home, the [[boerne-ungdomspsyk-center-aarhus|Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center]] at Aarhus Universitetshospital, situates her work within the broader effort—documented across the ADHD database reports for the periods 1 April 2023–31 March 2024 and 1 April 2024–31 March 2025—to track outcomes, regional variation, and educational attainment among children and young people diagnosed with or assessed for ADHD [^src1][^src2].
